page.layout: One printed page on the scan, with no text block. Faint mirrored text at the top and a faint engraving in the centre; the bottom lines are too faint to read. A library stamp sits at the centre.
page.notes: No printed text on this page that I can read reliably. The faint lines at the top (MELACHIM, REGVM LIBRI DVO, and the lines below them) appear mirrored and reversed, which means they are show-through from the printing on the other side of the leaf, so they are left out. The faint lines at the bottom, above and below the rectangular engraving, are also too faint and too reversed to transcribe. The circular library stamp of the Zürich cantonal library (Bibliothek der Kantonalen Anstalten, Zürich) is excluded as a library stamp. The rectangular faint image in the centre is an engraving or woodcut, not text. If the printed title page is needed, rescan the recto side at higher contrast or from the other side of the leaf.
